in_marathi.name: Kanaiya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Servant of Lord Krishna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kanaiya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name 'Kanaiya' is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a compound of two words: 'Kana' meaning 'Lord Krishna' and 'Iya' meaning 'Servant' or 'Dedicated To'. This name signifies devotion and dedication to Lord Krishna.
